tables.name: cdf-matchdata-required
tables.caption: Description of the mandatory Match Sheet Data CDF fields. Any description ending with a $^\star$ is repeated once per player. Only players named to the match day squad are listed. Any description ending with a $^\dagger$ is repeated once per event. Note that {i} is used as an index for the items in a list. Figure describes the specific format for providing results.

rows.description: Unique match identifier
Denotes whether the game was hosted in a neutral venue (true) or not (false)
Denotes whether the game went to extra time (true) or not (false)
Denotes whether the game had a penalty shootout (true) or not (false)
Result after the final whistle excluding penalty shootout goals (i.e. home goals, away goals)
Unique identifier of the winning team, null when the match was drawn and no shootout was played
Result after the first half (i.e. home goals, away goals)
Result after the second half (i.e. home goals, away goals)
Result after the first half of extra time (i.e. home goals, away goals). Only required if a game goes to extra time.
Result after the second half of extra time (i.e. home goals, away goals). Only required if a game goes to extra time.
Score for the penalty shootout (i.e. home goals, away goals, shootout goals only). Only required if a game goes to shootout.
Unique identifier for the home or away team
Unique player identifier$^\star$
First name$^\star$
Last name$^\star$
Unique team identifier denoting the team the player plays for$^\star$
Jersey number for a player$^\star$
Denotes whether a player started the game (true) or not (false)$^\star$
Denotes whether a player played in game (true) or not (false)$^\star$
Unique identifier for the official
Time a player scored$^\dagger$
Identifier of the player who scored$^\dagger$
Identifier of the player who assisted, if the goal was assisted else leave as null $^\dagger$.
Identifier of the team that scored (for own goals this should be identifier of the team that gained a goal). $^\dagger$
Denotes whether it was an own goal (true) or not (false)$^\dagger$
Denotes whether it was a penalty (true) or not (false)$^\dagger$
Team score after the goal$^\dagger$
Time in UTC a player is substituted in$^\dagger$
Unique identifier of the player substituted in$^\dagger$
Time the player was substituted out$^\dagger$
Identifier of the player that is substituted out$^\dagger$
Identifier of the team that made the substitution$^\dagger$
Time in UTC a player received a card$^\dagger$
Identifier of the player who received a card$^\dagger$
Type of card which can be yellow_card, red_card or second_yellow_card$^\dagger$
Identifier of the team that made the received a card$^\dagger$
Match sheet data vendor name (e.g. "company_a")
Period of the game when the goal was scored
Period of the game when the substitution occurred
Period of the game when the card was shown

tables.name: cdf-event-required
tables.caption: Description of the mandatory Event CDF fields. Every recorded event must include all these fields. The coordinate system is defined in Paragraph where the x axis is the sidelines and the y axis the goal lines. Note that {i} is used as an index for the items in a list.

rows.description: Unique match identifier
Indicates if synced tracking data is available (true) or not (false) for this event
Unique identifier of the event
Absolute time in UTC of when the event started (e.g., moment the pass is given, the moment the ball leaves the hands on a thrown in)
Period of the match which can be first_half, second_half, first_half_extratime, second_half_extratime, or shootout
Name of the event type (e.g. shot, pass, referee, defending, goalkeeping, misc etc.)

Name of the event sub type, which can be for shot - (penalty_kick, free_kick, corner_kick etc.); pass - (throw_in, free_kick, corner_kick, goal_kick, kick_off etc.); referee - (final_whistle, foul, caution, offside, substitution, player_on, player_off. Player on and player off events occur for example when a player has to abandon the game due to a lack of available substitutions, or as a temporary measure after a medical check); defending - (clearance, interception, pressing, block etc.); goalkeeping - (save, save_attempt, claim, etc.); misc - (other_ball_action, chance_without_shot, tackle, etc.)
Denotes whether the event was successful (true) or not (false)

Event outcome options: shot - (successful, saved, blocked, wide, woodwork, own_goal); pass - (e.g. successful, out_of_play, intercepted); referee - (start, end, injury, offside, yellow_card, red_card or second_yellow_card); defending - (e.g. clearance, block, interception, pressure); goalkeeping (e.g. save, save_attempt, claim); misc - (e.g. successful, unsuccessful)
Unique identifier of the player performing the action. For example, player committing a pass, or making a tackle. Required for all non-referee events. Referee events require event/official_id.
Unique team identifier of the player performing the action. Required for all non-referee events. Referee events require event/official_id.
Unique identifier of the player receiving a pass. Leave \textit{null} when the event is not a pass or when the pass has no receiver.
Absolute time in UTC of the first moment the ball was received. Leave \textit{null} when the event is not a pass or when the pass has no receiver.
x location where the action of player_id happened (m).
y location where the action of player_id happened (m).
x location where the action of player_id ended (m), null for single-point events that have no end coordinate.
y location where the action of player_id ended (m), null for single-point events that have no end coordinate.
Denotes the body part used by player_id, null allowed for events other than pass and shot.

Unique identifier(s) of the events related to the action, or pass and associated receival event. For example, a related aerial duel event or the player_off event associated with a player_on event. Leave null if no related events exist.
Unique identifier of the official performing the action. Mandatory only when type is referee, else use event/player_id and event/team_id
Unique team identifier of the player identified by receiver_id, leave null if the event does not end with a known player in possession

tables.name: cdf-event-optional
tables.caption: Description of the optional Event CDF fields. If included, these fields are recorded once per event.

rows.description: Frame identifier from the tracking data related to the event at (x, y) as described in ~\ref{tab:cdf-event-required}
Frame identifier from the tracking data related to the event at (x_end, y_end) as described in ~\ref{tab:cdf-event-required}
x location of the player committing an event according to the tracking data. For example, player committing a pass, or making a tackle (m)
y location of the player committing an event according to the tracking data. For example, player committing a pass, or making a tackle (m)

The match clock as a string in format "MM:SS.mm" (i.e. minutes, seconds, milliseconds) (e.g. "92:01.04"). The clock resets to "45:00.00", "90:00.00" or "105:00.00" at the start of "second_half", "first_half_extratime", "second_half_extratime", respectively.
Calculated xG value between [0,1]
Calculated post-shot xG value between [0,1]
Calculated expected pass value between [0,1]
Expected possession value between [0,1]
Was this event reviewed by the video assistant referee (true) or not (false)
Was the on-field ruling confirmed (true) or overturned (false)
